examples.text: La idea era tan avanzada que no podía entenderla.
examples.en: The idea was so advanced that I couldn't understand it.

examples.text: Su avanzada edad le impide conseguir un empleo.
examples.en: His advanced age prevents him from getting a job.

examples.text: Sus ideas eran demasiado avanzadas para ser aceptadas por la gente de a pie.
examples.en: His ideas were too far advanced to be accepted by ordinary people.
